title: Practice 3: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **среда → среду** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Таможенники поднялись на ___ (борт, acc. sg.) судна.
exercises.prompt: The customs officials boarded the ship.
exercises.why: **борт → борт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Закат окрасил небо в ___ (прекрасный цвет, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: The sunset painted the sky in beautiful colors.
exercises.why: **цвет → цвета** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. pl. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  **прекрасный → прекрасные** (acc. pl., agreeing with цвета). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: The cows in the meadow were mooing.
exercises.why: **луга → лугу** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сами чмокнул Лейлу в ___ (ягодица, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **ягодица → ягодицу** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Президент наложил вето на ___ (этот законопроект, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **законопроект → законопроект** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **этот → этот** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with законопроект). «этот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (m. sg.): этот · этого · этому · этот (inan.) / этого (anim.) · этим · этом.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я решил пойти в ___ (театр, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I've decided to go to the theater.
exercises.why: **театр → театр** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я намазываю на ___ (хлеб, acc. sg.) масло.
exercises.why: **хлеб → хлеб** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том и Мэри пели в ___ (унисон, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary sang in unison.
exercises.why: **унисон → унисон** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Его мнение проливает новый свет на ___ (проблема, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: His opinion adds a new light to the question.
exercises.why: **проблема → проблему** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**дерево → дерево** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**выключатель → выключатель** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like автомобиль (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Водителя повело на скользкой дороге, и он врезался в ___ (ограждение, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The driver skidded on a slippery road and collided with the crash barrier.
exercises.why: **ограждение → ограждение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Роуз встала, чтобы положить розовую икру на ___ (свой ряд, acc. pl.) роз.
exercises.prompt: Rose rose to put rose roes on her rows of roses.
exercises.why: **ряд → ряды** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like стол (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  **свой → свои** (acc. pl., agreeing with ряды). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: Tom is looking in the mirror.
exercises.why: **зеркало → зеркало** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (последнее время, acc. sg.) все слишком подорожало.
exercises.prompt: These days, everything has got too expensive.
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like имя (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **последний → последнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). Declines like синий (A. синее). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: I need you for just a second.
exercises.why: **секундочка → секундочку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не впихивайте больше ничего в ___ (сундук, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Don't squeeze any more into the trunk.
exercises.why: **сундук → сундук** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты вешал афиши на ___ (стена, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: You hung posters on the wall.
exercises.why: **стена → стену** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
